additional_info.subject: RE: ID0424328-DC/Si-D/FR-[ MP / R6 170002075 ] station is in "Unavailable" state CRM:02684000233
additional_info.body:
Dear Malek Drif,
I hope you are doing well.
As per the reported timestamp, we have checked the logs and found that the charger outlet went
unavailable for a short period
and then returned to the
ready
state. This occurred due to a
charger reboot
at that time.
Please refer to the following log entries confirming the reboot and outlet unavailability
2025-05-14T07:48:04.276814+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/680342b1b078[730]: PLC-Error-Flag 'PerformingCollaboratedReboot' changed from false - ('Reboot inactive') to true - ('Reboot active...EMG stop to all outlets')
2025-05-14T07:48:05.207919+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/680342b1b078[730]: OCPP: Send command: StatusNotification (9476485b-7d96-4dbf-adcb-6751c82756dd) - {"connectorId":1,"errorCode":"NoError","status":"Unavailable"}
Following the reboot, all outlets returned to the
ready
state, and the charging session was completed successfully.
Please see below:
2025-05-15T03:30:48.424923+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/680342b1b078[737]: setOutletLedState ready 2
2025-05-14T07:56:58.753430+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/680342b1b078[737]: setOutletLedState ready 2
2025-05-14T07:56:58.769448+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/680342b1b078[737]: setOutletLedState ready 1
Additionally, we have observed some
error flags related to the converter
and
Meter_BC6_AC_Income
. To address this, we will coordinate with our
regional team
for further analysis and resolution. Once we have more information or a resolution plan, we will reach out to you accordingly.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Abhinav Malokar
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
